description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to WebSocket protocol handling within the WPEFramework. It includes protocol enums, request and response allocators, and link type templates for WebSocket client and server implementations, including upgrade and message handling logic.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame types, masking, encoding/decoding, and request/response key generation.

classes.name: RequestAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Request objects.

classes.name: ResponseAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Response objects.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class defining the WebSocket link behavior, including message serialization, deserialization, upgrade handling, and state management for client and server links.

classes.name: WebSocketClientType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket client implementation, managing connection, message exchange, and upgrade process.

classes.name: WebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket server implementation, managing incoming connections, message handling, and upgrade process.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket response key based on a request key.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of the allocator.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data frames for WebSocket transmission.
